name: Start File Submission
description: Submit files from the playbook run's storage to VMRay and return right away, without waiting for the analyses: check them later with Check Submission Status.

shareable.description: If set to true, the hash of the sample will be shared with VirusTotal.
shareable.title: Shareable

max_recursive_samples.description: The maximum amount of recursive samples which will be analyzed (at most 10). 0 disables recursion.
max_recursive_samples.title: Max Recursive Samples

max_jobs.description: Limits the amount of jobs that can be created by jobrules for a submission.
max_jobs.title: Max Jobs

enable_reputation.description: If set to true, reputation lookups will be performed for submitted samples and analysis artifacts (file hash and URL lookups) by the VMRay cloud reputation service and additional third party services. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
enable_reputation.title: Enable Reputation

enable_whois.description: If set to true, domains seen during analyses are queried with external WHOIS service. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
enable_whois.title: Enable Whois

analyzer_mode.description: Specifies which types of analyzers will be used for analyzing this sample. Supported strings are 'reputation', 'reputation_static', 'reputation_static_dynamic', 'static_dynamic', and 'static'. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
analyzer_mode.title: Analyzer Mode

known_malicious.description: If set to true, triage will be used to pre-filter known malicious samples by results of reputation lookup (if allowed) and static analysis. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
known_malicious.title: Known Malicious

known_benign.description: If set to true, triage will be used to pre-filter known benign samples by results of reputation lookup (if allowed) and static analysis. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
known_benign.title: Known Benign

files.description: Files to submit, as paths in the playbook run's data storage — e.g. the `files` of SentinelOne's Get malwares from threat, given as is: a list of {"path": ...} objects or of paths.
files.title: Files

reanalyze.description: If set to true, known samples will be re-analyzed on submission. This is enabled by default.
reanalyze.title: Reanalyze

tags.description: Tags to attach to the sample.
tags.title: Tags

submitted.description: True when VMRay accepted at least one submission.
submitted.title: Submitted

submission_ids.description: IDs of the submissions VMRay started. They are not finished yet: give them to Check Submission Status.
submission_ids.title: Submission IDs

errors.description: Errors VMRay returned on submit, and the files it could not take.
errors.title: Errors

submitted_files.description: Files VMRay accepted. A file that could not be read or was refused is in `errors`.
submitted_files.title: Submitted Files
